name: Mizuho Kanna
source: Unemployed for several long months, she's depressed and drinks way too much, as it is not uncommon to find her asleep on the floor at any time of the day. In fact, we don't know that much about her, as she’s practically invisible (except when she’s drunk). And aren’t the quietest the most dangerous?
